setup.brief: An Art Nouveau orchid conservatory: flowing iron ribs, curved translucent glasshouse, raised planters and a real hinged entrance door. Rich forest green iron, warm brass accents and vivid orchid clusters. Distinct curved silhouette; visible interior rather than a solid glass blob.

A sculptural open-air tea pavilion: sweeping asymmetrical timber lamella roof curling up at one end, convincing beams and benches beneath, stone plinth and a restrained tea setting. Show custom curved geometry, elegant negative space and restrained warm timber/ivory/charcoal palette.

setup.brief: A clockwork manta ray automaton: copper and deep teal curved segmented wings, mechanical body with visible real linkage and a smoothly looping wing flap. Wings should read as a manta silhouette rather than flat boxes. Carefully attached mechanisms and polished brass details.

A compact alpine cable-car terminal: curved roof station with exposed pulley assembly, supporting frame, boarding platform and one red gondola suspended correctly on the cable. Snow-free architectural model, pine green roof and warm wood, clean crafted proportions. Animate a small coherent service mechanism.

setup.brief: A sophisticated brass and cobalt-glass iris lantern: six overlapping sculpted aperture blades around a luminous inner chamber, articulated opening animation, rounded base and finely crafted collar/hinges. The mechanism must visibly open and remain attached, with controlled emissive brightness and rich material contrast.
